**Onimusha 3: Demon Siege Fusion Fix** corrects resolution handling, aspect ratio, HUD scaling, field of view and video scaling for widescreen displays.



[Website](https://thirteenag.github.io/wfp#onimusha3) · [Source Code](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/WidescreenFixesPack/blob/master/source/Onimusha3.FusionFix/dllmain.cpp)



</div>



---



Extract the release archive into the game directory, preserving folders, then launch the game.

## Configuration



Configure on fusionfix.io or in FusionFixHub. Resolution defaults to the desktop size; choose another size through the game’s Resolution row or set a width and height in the editor. Resolution changes apply immediately. Window Mode chooses fullscreen, a resizable window or a borderless window on the current monitor; changes apply immediately. A bordered window keeps the chosen client resolution, including at desktop size. Resolution and window mode are excluded from presets. Video Mode changes apply during playback: Original keeps the whole 4:3 picture with black bars, and Fill enlarges it past the black bars stored in the videos until their wide picture fits the screen, without cutting the picture. Recommended and Enhanced use Fill; Vanilla uses Original.



HUD Box places the gameplay HUD at the screen edges in Auto, or within a centered 4:3, 16:9, 21:9 or 32:9 box. A custom W:H or decimal ratio can also be entered. The HUD keeps its proportions and native margins.



Cutscene Borders selects Off, Letterbox, Pillarbox or Both. Animated Cutscene Borders keeps the game’s native fade; turn it off for immediate borders. Vanilla keeps the original letterbox; Recommended and Enhanced also add pillarbox bars.







Skip Intro removes startup logos and the optional startup logo movie. Skip Press Start goes directly to the title menu. Save-device checks and their choices remain available. Story and attract movies still play. Restart after changing this option.



FOV Factor changes the normal gameplay camera’s field of view. The default is 1.0. Pause on Focus Loss and Confine Cursor apply to windowed play and can be changed while the game is running. Ctrl+F10 opens the developer overlay, with the shared Supporter panel when access has not been activated.



Frame Limit changes presentation: 0 is unlimited, -1 follows the monitor refresh rate, or choose 30–1000 FPS. The game’s simulation keeps its original 60 updates per second. Recommended uses 60 FPS; Enhanced removes the presentation cap.

XInput controllers use the bundled Xidi with the supplied Onimusha 3 layout. A interacts, B absorbs souls or cancels, X attacks and Y uses magic. LB guards, RB readies the weapon, LT opens the map and RT turns around. Start pauses, Back opens inventory, LS transforms and RS performs the firefly jump. PlayStation controllers can use Steam Input or DS4Windows; select PlayStation icons in the settings.

Game Language selects the game’s own text and fonts after a restart. Text Language selects the plugin’s settings language immediately. Saves stay in the game’s SAVE folder when it is writable. If that folder cannot be written, saves use Saved Games\Onimusha 3\SAVE, copying an existing save only when the destination has none.

## Known limits



- Window-mode and startup-skip changes require a restart.

- Backgrounds and menus retain their centered 4:3 design.



## Notes



Open Options → Plugins → Onimusha 3 Fusion Fix to change settings in the game. Full help, presets and Details are available there. Changes that need a restart show a warning; reverting them clears it. The Plugins page supports English, French, German, Italian and Spanish. Check for Updates is optional and shows a notice in this page when a newer release is available.
